card.name: Short unit abbreviations like mcg, mL, mm
card.fires_on: Short letter groups that begin or sit inside a unit or abbreviation, such as the mc in mcg, the cc in cc RCC, mm, mg, or the mv command. Mostly after a number or in a dosing line.

modes.label: Micrograms and units
modes.description: The mc part of mcg after a dose number.
modes.example: 4<< mc>>g given by bolus intravenous administration

modes.label: Other short abbreviations
modes.description: Two-letter abbreviations such as bc, cc, mm, mv or Mt in dose, cancer-type or technical text.

card.plain: It fires on the first letters of short unit or abbreviation strings like mcg, mL or mm, mostly in dosing text.
